stories.title: UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara ends after 35 years
stories.summary: The UN's Western Sahara peacekeeping mission ceased operations Sunday after 35 years, a casualty of a US-Russia standoff at the Security Council over the disputed territory's future.

stories.title: Southeast Asian leaders open ASEAN summit in Manila
stories.summary: The 49th ASEAN Summit opened in Manila on Sunday, with the Myanmar conflict, South China Sea tensions and regional trade topping the agenda for the three-day gathering.

stories.title: Judge blocks Trump plan to close Washington DC golf course
stories.summary: A federal judge issued a temporary order Sunday blocking the Trump administration's plan to shut down and renovate the East Potomac Golf Links, the latest step in a months-long dispute over the public course.

stories.title: Apple's Siri-powered smart glasses reportedly launching next year
stories.summary: Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship them before year-end, per Mark Gurman: iPhone-tethered frames built around Siri AI and third-party app integration.

stories.title: Bessent urges Nvidia to hire an outside CEO, questions China sales
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent questioned whether Nvidia's earnings were inflated by chip sales routed to China and gave the board 10 days to answer, urging a dramatic shakeup with an external CEO.

stories.title: Hyundai Home Shopping debuts AI broadcasts with no hosts or cameras
stories.summary: Hyundai Home Shopping launched AI-REAL, a system that generates entire sales broadcasts - voice, visuals and product scenes - with no human hosts, cutting partner production costs by more than 80% in a pilot.

stories.title: Browns announce inactives for Week 10 vs. Texans
stories.summary: Cleveland released its inactive list for Sunday's home game against Houston, the Browns' final contest before their bye week.

stories.title: Browns host Texans in Week 10 with bye week on deck
stories.summary: Cleveland hosts Houston at Huntington Bank Field on Sunday, looking to snap a two-game losing streak and reach its bye week on an upswing.

stories.title: Eleven Warriors: Ohio State should skip a non-playoff bowl game
stories.summary: With the Buckeyes' playoff path narrow after Saturday's 28-19 win over Northwestern, Eleven Warriors argues OSU has little to gain from a non-playoff bowl and should turn its focus to 2027.

stories.title: Ohio judge strikes down last parts of state's abortion 'Heartbeat Law'
stories.summary: An Ohio judge tossed out the final remnants of the state's six-week abortion ban, ruling doctors are not legally required to ask why a patient seeks an abortion or test for fetal cardiac activity.

stories.title: Person shot in south Columbus overnight
stories.summary: One person was hospitalized in critical condition after an overnight shooting near Parsons Avenue and East Innis Avenue in south Columbus, with no suspect information released.

stories.title: Ohio State nurses call for investigation of Wexner Medical Center leaders
stories.summary: Nurses at Ohio State's Wexner Medical Center are calling for an investigation of executive staff members, tied to a new incentive program at the hospital.
